name: Vimta Labs Ltd
tagline: Clean, debt-free CRO / testing-services compounder (~24% ROCE, consistent dividend) with a real NDCT regulatory tailwind and a biologics option - but Q1 FY27 growth decelerated to ~12-14% (below the 20-25% target), the stock trades at ~36x, and an old but disclosed Ranbaxy-era data-integrity stain gave one trusted investor pause
business_overview: Contract research and testing services company (clinical research, bioanalytical/preclinical, food/water/environment testing, biopharmaceutical testing, and now biologics via a new CRAD facility) operating since 1990 from a ~200,000 sq ft base in Genome Valley, Hyderabad. USFDA / WHO / NABL-accredited labs.

FY26 EBITDA margin 35.8% (Rs 149 Cr); Q1 FY27 36.4% with slight sequential pressure; PAT margin ~18.6%
0.01 (debt-free); FY27 capex Rs 80 Cr (Rs 10 Cr biologics + Rs 70 Cr routine) fully self-funded; consistent Rs 2/share dividend (FY26)
fundamentals_narrative: Fundamentals are genuinely clean and among the best in this batch - ROCE 24.24%, ROE 17.82%, effectively debt-free (D/E 0.01), 5-year profit CAGR ~30%, a consistent Rs 2/share dividend, and FY27 capex of Rs 80 Cr funded entirely from internal accruals. Two things frame the near term. (1) Tailwind: the Sept 2025 NDCT amendments cut clinical-trial approval timelines from 90 to 45 days for most drug categories - a direct throughput tailwind for Vimta's clinical-research vertical, which was under pressure in FY26 and is now 'showing early signs of recovery'. A new biologics testing vertical (CRAD facility) went operational in Q1 FY27 with its first order booked, though meaningful revenue is not expected until FY29+. (2) The near-term numbers lag the story: Q1 FY27 revenue grew only ~11.85% (total income +13.7%), well below management's 20-25% / ~Rs 500 Cr FY27 target, and EBITDA margin showed slight sequential pressure. At ~36x trailing P/E and ~18-19x EV/EBITDA the market is pricing a reacceleration that is not yet visible. The mid-2000s Ranbaxy bioequivalence-data-fabrication episode (documented in 'Bottle of Lies', discussed on-thread) is 20+ years old and disclosed - it caused trusted member Marathondreams to pass on cultural-risk grounds but does not meet this project's HIGH CAUTION bar. Promoter holding is only ~36% (no pledge/encumbrance, confirmed FY26), with a competitor separately holding ~19% and senior-management salaries flagged (unresolved) as a governance watch item.
